in_sanskrit.name: ज्ञानधिः
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is full of knowledge or wisdom

in_marathi.name: Jnanadhi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jnanadhi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'Jnana' (wisdom) and 'Aadi' (river), Jnanadhi symbolizes the flow of knowledge and wisdom.

in_bengali.name: Jnanadhi
